name: gleam-desktop
description: Gleam — a local-first desktop AI agent. Configuration and data stay on this machine.
author: Gleam

scripts.build: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build:ts
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-runtimes.mjs win32 x64 && npm run trim:runtimes -- win32 x64 && node scripts/pack-desktop.mjs --win nsis
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-runtimes.mjs linux x64 && npm run trim:runtimes -- linux x64 && node scripts/pack-desktop.mjs --linux dir

sprintf-js.reason: Transitive dep: roarr → global-agent → @electron/get → electron-builder. No patched version exists. Vulnerability requires attacker-controlled format strings, not possible in this logging chain. Low risk for desktop app.
